the effects of cerebral hemidecorticectomy on the neostriatal levels of TGF alpha mRNA.
the role of the neostiatum (caudate nucleus) in the development of the motor system.

hemidecorticate rats have a significant increase in TGF alpha expression in the ipsilateral striatum at all ages tested.
